span: permissibility of special provisions (including reservation) based on economic criteria
why: Concerns economic-criteria reservation (EWS), not reservation in promotion for SC/ST.

span: G.O.Ms. No. 3/2000 providing for 100% reservation is not permissible under the Constitution
why: Headnote on 100% reservation of teacher posts for scheduled tribes in scheduled areas; not promotion.

span: However, the conclusion in M. Nagaraj case that the State has to collect quantifiable data showing backwardness of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes, being contrary to the nine-Judge Bench in Indra Sawhney (1) case, is held to be invalid to this extent.
why: Headnote on reservation in promotion under Art. 16(4-A): removes the backwardness-data condition for SC/ST, which supports permissibility, but the passage does not state the general permission itself.
